display.purpose: Hero headlines only, on the dark ink slab.

headline.purpose: Section opens and page titles on light surfaces.

body.purpose: Reading text; muted ink on light, white/60 on ink slabs.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, metadata, pills, timestamps, form hints — anything that is data, not prose.

motion.name: ease-ios
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions — fast natural deceleration.

motion.name: glass-interactive-hover
motion.value: transform 0.45s var(--ease-ios), box-shadow 0.45s var(--ease-ios), background-color 0.45s var(--ease-ios)
motion.purpose: Card hover lift: translateY(-3px) + lifted shadow.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Button press feedback — the iOS cue.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action per screen — brand red fill with a subtle inset highlight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: oklch(0.565 0.208 27.5); color: oklch(0.99 0.002 95); font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.22); transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.565 0.208 27.5 / 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — hairline border, ink text, faint fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.18 0.012 265); font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 0.10); border-radius: 4px; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 0.045); border-color: oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 0.25); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.565 0.208 27.5 / 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Button (CTA)
components.description: The liquid-glass CTA for hero / on-ink moments — frosted, sheen sweep, springy lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.62); color: oklch(0.18 0.012 265); font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 0.08); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 5%), 0 12px 32px -8px oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 12%), inset 0 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), box-shadow 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 6%), 0 24px 56px -12px oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 18%), inset 0 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.85); } .ds-btn-cta:active { transform: translateY(-1px) scale(0.995); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.565 0.208 27.5 / 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The listing surface — frosted glass over the ambient field, springy hover lift.
components.html:
Event title

Short description of the event.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.62); border: 1px solid oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 0.08); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 5%), 0 12px 32px -8px oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 12%), inset 0 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), box-shadow 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-glass-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 6%), 0 24px 56px -12px oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 18%), inset 0 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.85); } .ds-glass-card-media { height: 160px; background: #e5e5e0; } .ds-glass-card h3 { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 16px 20px 4px; } .ds-glass-card p { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.505 0.014 265); margin: 0 20px 20px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline-bordered field with a warm-white fill; focus ring in brand red.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.18 0.012 265); } .ds-input input { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.18 0.012 265); background: oklch(1 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 0.12); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.505 0.014 265); } .ds-input input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.565 0.208 27.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.565 0.208 27.5 / 0.45); } .ds-input input:focus-visible { outline: none; }

components.name: Mono Pill / Tag
components.description: Small uppercase mono chip for metadata and status — the data signal.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-weight: 500; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 3px; line-height: 1; background: oklch(0.565 0.208 27.5 / 0.10); color: oklch(0.565 0.208 27.5); }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Theme-aware glass bar; links are current-colour translucent text that fills on hover/active.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.62); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.18 0.012 265 / 0.10); padding: 0 16px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.2 0.012 265 / 0.6); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 3px; transition: color 0.3s, background-color 0.3s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(0.2 0.012 265); background: oklch(0.2 0.012 265 / 0.07); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: oklch(0.2 0.012 265); background: oklch(0.2 0.012 265 / 0.12); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.565 0.208 27.5 / 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The site reads as a student society's editorial notebook pressed under frosted glass — tight display headings and mono metadata floating above soft ambient colour, with every surface a translucent pane that picks up the light behind it. It is warm, precise, and quietly confident: the paper is never pure white, the red is never a hard alert, and the ink is slightly cool where it types and slightly warm where it slabs. Light mode is a warm paper page with near-white glass cards; dark mode is a cool ink page with darker glass. The hero and navigation stay a deep warm ink in both themes so the landing reads as one continuous slab. Density is editorial — generous section spacing, hairline borders, and one accent colour used sparingly. The system deliberately avoids gradients, glows, and card-bloat: depth comes from blur, specular hairlines, and soft lifted shadows, not from filling surfaces with colour.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper / cool ink neutrals, one deepened brand red
Liquid-glass surfaces: translucent fill + backdrop-filter blur + specular top edge + soft shadow
Editorial typography: tight Instrument Sans display, Martian Mono for metadata/pills
The (parenthetical) accent word — red, inline, the signature flourish
Dark ink hero + nav slab in both themes
No gradients, no glow, motion is springy-but-not-bouncy (--ease-ios)

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The brand red appears on a small fraction of any screen: the accent word, one hover, one primary action. Its scarcity is what makes it read as accent.

rules.name: The One-Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is either the ink (cool-ink / light-on-dark) or a translucent version of it. Never introduce a second text colour — blue links, purple links, and rainbow emphasis are rejected.

rules.name: The Data-Versus-Prose Rule
rules.body: If it's a number, timestamp, tag, or eyebrow, set it in mono. If it's a sentence, set it in sans. Mixed usage is the signal that separates metadata from content.

rules.name: The Parenthetical Rule
rules.body: Emphasise the second word of a title by wrapping it in parentheses and setting it in the brand red ((Start here.), (Upcoming) Events). The paren is the signature accent — use it on headings, not body copy.

rules.name: The Layered-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Elevation is expressed with backdrop blur + a specular hairline + a soft shadow together. Never a hard offset block shadow, never a glow.

rules.name: The Springy-Never-Bouncy Rule
rules.body: All motion uses --ease-ios (cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)) — a fast, natural deceleration. Hover lifts -3px, press scales to 0.995.

dos: Do set page and section backgrounds with the tokens (bg-background, bg-card, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, border-border) — the oklch token system is the single source of truth.
Do use glass + glass-interactive for major listing cards, and the hairline+ambient treatment for quieter surfaces.
Do keep the brand red rare — one accent per screen, at most.
Do lead section and page titles with a mono-label eyebrow and use the (paren) accent word for the second term of a display heading.
Do let the header and mobile menu adopt the theme: light frosted in light mode, dark ink in dark mode, dark ink on the home hero.
Do set small metadata (dates, tags, counts, labels) in Martian Mono.
donts: Don't reintroduce hard-coded #990000-style reds, raw oklch(...) literals, or the legacy bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 page wrappers — remap them to tokens.
Don't use red/gradient hero backgrounds (from-red-600 via-red-700 to-red-800). Heroes are dark ink slabs with an interior radial glow, or nothing.
Don't use border-l-4 side-tab accents, bounce/elastic easing, or gradient text — all rejected.
Don't add a second text colour (blue links etc.) or place grey text on the red accent; on colour, use the surface's own ink or near-white.
Don't paint a solid opaque panel for the mobile menu — it inherits the header's glass so it blurs what's behind it.
Don't ship an unlabeled icon button or an unlabeled form control; use aria-label or a wrapping FieldGroup.
